text: City Council on April 24, 25, 26 and 27, 2018, referred Item TE3l.31 back to the Toronto and East York Community Council for further consideration. This report recommends that City Council deny the request for a permit to remove one (1) privately owned tree located at 164 Westwood Avenue. The application indicates the reasons for removal are to address concerns over the condition of the tree and risk of the tree failing due to the construction of a house on the neighbouring property. The subject tree is a silver maple (Acer saccharinum), measuring 77 cm in diameter. The Private Tree By-law does not support the removal of this tree as it is healthy and maintainable.
The Toronto and East York Community Council deferred consideration of the item until its January 2019 meeting.
